newsitem.title: USA: Blonder says Pacific Bell contract ended.
newsitem.headline: Blonder says Pacific Bell contract ended.

text.p: Blonder Tongue Laboratories Inc on Monday said its interdiction contract with Pacific Bell was terminated.
The company, which makes electronics and systems equipment for the franchised and private cable television industries, said the decision should not have a significant impact on earnings.
"While we are disappointed about Pacific Bell's decision, it should have an insignificant effect on 1997 sales or earnings," said James Luksch, chairman of the board, president and chief executive.

Blonder said the announcement came in response to the recent SBC Communications Inc statement that, as a result of its merger with Pacific Bell, it curtailed plans to enter the market for wired delivery of video and halted construction of its hybrid fiber-coaxial network in San Jose, California.

The company said interdiction sales and order input throughout the second quarter exceeded expectations. It said it was optimistic about opportunities in the franchised cable market, notwithstanding the Pacific Bell decision.
